skills.name: Find and apply common denominator
skills.definition: Determine an LCD for unlike denominators and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract and simplify common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fraction quantities once they share a denominator by operating on numerators, keeping the denominator, and reducing or converting zero results as needed.

skills.name: Separate and combine mixed or whole parts
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers or whole numbers as whole-plus-fraction parts, subtract whole-number parts, and combine the resulting whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Borrow or regroup across whole and fraction
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction would be negative, regroup one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fractional units before completing the subtraction.
